role: XCTest suite for Verification (session data-quality gate): too-few-points, duration, artifact/ectopy/out-of-bounds thresholds, signal-loss gaps, RR drift, custom/strict configs, metrics and summary text, with English pinned.
types: VerificationTests: class (@MainActor XCTestCase) — Verification.verify scenarios with synthetic RR series

units.does: Per-test setup: super.setUp then pinEnglishLanguage (sets LanguageManager to English and restores in teardown if the host is not English).
units.entry: XCTest runner: async setUp before each test

units.does: Fixture: RRSeries of `count` points with uniform rr_ms (default 800) and t_ms = i*rr_ms, random sessionId, start Date().
Fixture: `total` ArtifactFlags where the first artifactCount are artifacts of `type` (default .technical, confidence 0.9) and the rest .clean.
Fixture: flagsWithArtifacts with type .ectopic.
Asserts 100 points (<300 minimum) fails with only .tooFewPoints and metrics.pointCount 100.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts 300 points at 800 ms is not rejected for tooFewPoints but is rejected for tooShort (240 s < 0.083 h) and does not pass.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass
